styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Stanley Park, the seawall and the North Shore mountains.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Granville Island, Asian eats and seafood.

stays.why: Central for SkyTrain, shops and the seawall; walk to most sights.
Quiet streets next to Stanley Park and English Bay beaches.
Lively restaurants and bars by the water; easy Canada Line access.
Historic brick streets, cafés and nightlife; close to Waterfront station.

food: Try Pacific salmon and spot prawns in season; ask what is local that day.
Granville Island Public Market: graze cheese, bread and fruit, then sit by the water.
Richmond has excellent Chinese food; the Canada Line gets you there in about 25 minutes.
Cheap eats: sushi, ramen and food trucks downtown, roughly CAD 10–20 a meal.
Book popular dinner spots ahead; weekend brunch queues are long.
more_time: Swap a city day for Capilano Suspension Bridge or Grouse Mountain; check prices and shuttle options on the day.
Take the SeaBus to North Vancouver for the Lonsdale Quay market and skyline views.
Rent a bike (Mobi) and ride more of the seawall toward Kitsilano and the beaches.

recommend.why: Two nights covers Stanley Park, Granville Island and Gastown; add a night for the North Shore mountains.

month_notes: Cold and wet: highs near 6°C, about 18 rain days. Pack a waterproof jacket.
Coldest month, lows near 1°C, 16 rain days. Snow is rare downtown but possible on the hills.
Still cool and showery, highs near 9°C. Cherry blossoms start late in the month.
Milder, highs near 12°C, 15 rain days. Good for walking with a rain layer.
Warmer and drier: highs near 16°C, 9 rain days. Great for the seawall.
Mild and pleasant, highs near 19°C, about 10 rain days. Long daylight hours.
Warmest and driest: highs near 22°C, only 5 rain days. Book hotels early.
Hot and dry, highs near 23°C. Best beach month; pack sunscreen.
Still warm at 18°C but rain returns (12 days). Carry a light rain jacket.
Cooler and wetter: highs near 13°C, 15 rain days. Good museum weather.
Cool and rainy, highs near 9°C, 19 rain days. Bring waterproof shoes.
Wettest month: highs near 6°C, about 20 rain days. Expect grey, damp days.

climate_guide.summary: Mild coastal climate: wet, cool winters and warm, dry summers. Rain is common from October to March.

items.title: Best time: June to September
items.text: Warm highs of 19–23°C and the fewest rain days. Ideal for parks, beaches and the seawall.

items.title: Wet winters
items.text: November to January brings 19–20 rain days a month. Pack a waterproof jacket and shoes.

items.title: Mild, not freezing
items.text: Winter highs stay near 6°C and lows near 1–2°C. Snow is uncommon downtown.

items.title: Short beach season
items.text: July and August are the only reliably warm beach months, around 22–23°C.

items.title: Spring is showery
items.text: March to May warms from 9°C to 16°C but rain days stay at 9–16. Bring layers.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers, a rain jacket and comfortable walking shoes year-round; sunscreen and a hat for summer.

transit.best: SkyTrain for the airport and downtown; walk or bike the seawall.

modes.text: SkyTrain Canada Line links YVR to downtown in about 25 minutes. Expo and Millennium lines plus SeaBus ferries cover the region.
TransLink buses run frequent local routes; N10 runs overnight from the airport.
Taxis accept credit cards; Uber and Lyft operate in Vancouver.
Driving is easy outside rush hour; downtown parking is costly.
Walking and bike share (Mobi) suit the compact downtown and seawall.
SeaBus ferries are part of TransLink and cross to North Vancouver.
